name: Fieldschool
description: A complete creative learning site with live color, typography and layout exercises, saved experiments and an exportable field notebook.

notes.layout: Asymmetric paper-collage hero, original course posters, instructional manifesto, real lesson studios and a personal notebook
notes.motion: Restrained poster hover, specimen color transitions and responsive composition changes
notes.interaction: Filter courses, measure color contrast, adjust typography and layout, save reflections and export a notebook
notes.provenance: Six independently composed pages with original course content and artwork, three functioning browser exercises and local learning records.
